title: Report coordination overhead per completed change in the delivery benchmark
body:
Outcome: the delivery benchmark reports coordination overhead per completed change — messages between agents, agreements or decisions recorded, and documents written — next to merged changes, so organisational activity cannot pass for progress.
Evidence: operator intake 2026-11-02 (pasted digest, item 3): in a YC/Olam Labs experiment 50 agents sent ~5900 messages in three hours and four spent 11 minutes agreeing on one operator for one fertilising step. Owner of the benchmark: t-6vhm7we.
